purpose: 1.4 m classroom utility-tunnel digital-twin physical demonstrator
required_parts: transparent acrylic tunnel with A/B/C zones and service access
sealed annular G01 monitored gas-pipeline object, plus a separate C-zone ventilation route with readable flow arrows
CH4, CO and O2 sample modules; smoke detector; three zone temperature modules
controlled drip point, isolated water tray, leak probe and independent high-level float
door and door-magnetic contact, control cabinet, network module, emergency stop
fan tachometer/current-feedback modules, lighting and sound-light alarm
relations: fan is visibly in series with the separate C-zone ventilation route, not the monitored gas pipe
G01 is visibly sealed and does not imply an unsafe classroom gas-flow experiment
drip point leads only to the raised isolated tray, never to the control bay
each interactive core asset has a readable code label and semantic mesh name
review_questions: Can a reviewer distinguish the sealed monitored pipe from the safe ventilation route?
Are all required sensing, feedback and safety functions visible and individually identifiable?
Are the inner parts readable through the acrylic enclosure?
